title: Quartic-optimal motions through the K1727 seed form an affine one-dimensional tangent family

tangent.reason: K1726 requires the scaled sixth-Hermite coordinate to equal 35/3; the base point already has h8/u^2=35, whose first motion does not change the quartic coefficient because the completed square is stationary there.
tangent.rank: The kappa6 gradient is nonzero, so one nontrivial affine equation in (P,A) leaves one free tangent parameter.

k1728_representative.description: Holding the unnormalized radii A0,B0 fixed and varying their lower-radius probability gives one chart tangent, not the unique quartic optimizer motion.

scope_guard: The affine family is a first-order path statement through the K1727 seed. It neither proves that every member continues globally nor selects the exact finite-strength minimizer.
